detection_method: CODEJUDGE LLM evaluator flags missing exception handling and invalid-input or edge-case handling
mitigation_method: Prompt instructions require input validation and exception handling; the experiment reports robustness changes
scope_limit: Detection depends on an evaluator and prompt; mitigation covers one model, 20 Python CoderEval tasks, human scoring, and correctness/readability/conciseness trade-offs.

detection_method: Cognitive complexity and SonarQube code-smell, naming, and structure flags provide automated readability proxies
mitigation_method: Prompt instructions request meaningful comments and readability; the experiment reports small readability changes
scope_limit: Detection uses structural proxies rather than general semantic comprehensibility; mitigation covers one model, 20 Python tasks, and observed trade-offs.

detection_method: RPG uses grammar reduction plus suffix and longest-common-prefix arrays to detect repetition during decoding
mitigation_method: RPG penalizes token scores associated with detected structural or content repetition
scope_limit: Covers repetition degeneration only and requires white-box token scores and grammar access; it does not cover task misunderstanding, omitted code, or ignored feedback.

detection_method: GHArchive metadata and go-license-detector identify repository licenses
mitigation_method: Repositories outside a permissive-license allowlist are excluded
scope_limit: Repository-level metadata and an allowlist do not resolve file-level rights, missing licenses, compatibility, or general legal compliance.

detection_method: Pylint and static readability scores quantify dataset code understandability
mitigation_method: Six automated refactoring tools transform formatting, comments, imports, and related code properties
scope_limit: Five Python fine-tuning datasets and Pylint/formatting proxies; aggregate downstream improvement was not significant and some dataset-model combinations declined.

detection_method: Sensitive-term matching and named-entity recognition identify six PII categories
mitigation_method: Matching records are deleted and detected PII is replaced with typed placeholders
scope_limit: A fixed term list and six entity types cannot cover all privacy, security, or legal risks.

detection_method: DataMan predicts one of 15 domains and records source and domain distributions
mitigation_method: MG-Verilog randomly samples different description-detail levels during each fine-tuning iteration to balance global and local semantics
scope_limit: Detection uses SlimPajama general text and 15 domains; mitigation concerns description-granularity balance in Verilog with one CodeLLaMA-7B setting, not universal language or domain balance.

detection_method: Exact matching plus 256-permutation MinHash, LSH, and a Jaccard threshold identify duplicate files
mitigation_method: One exact copy is retained and near-duplicate clusters are reduced
scope_limit: File-level lexical duplication only; semantic clones and cross-representation duplication are outside scope.

detection_method: DataComp-LM tooling flags pages containing benchmark questions and answer options
mitigation_method: Matched benchmark question and option strings are removed before retraining
scope_limit: General-text MMLU and HellaSwag string matching with reported false positives; semantic and code-benchmark contamination remain uncovered.

detection_method: Repository scores and file rules flag low-star, low-commit, empty, corrupt, generated, long, or oversized material
mitigation_method: The bottom repository-score decile and files matching configured low-value rules are removed
scope_limit: Surface proxies and selected thresholds can remove useful data and do not detect factual, logical, or task-relevance defects.
